description: This is a Svelte component for user authentication, managing login, signup, and logout functionality using an external auth store.

methods.name: handleSignup
methods.description: Handles user signup by calling the auth.signup method, updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles user login by calling the auth.login method, redirects to home on success.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Handles user logout by calling the auth.logout method, resets form fields.
